svg.title: How Undivided Society Is Established — a dependency chain
svg.desc: Coexistence provisions mutuality; human understanding establishes justice; family, institutions, dialogue, and education carry humane orderliness toward undivided society.
svg.text: How Undivided Society Is Established
A dependency chain from coexistence to publicly evidenced humane orderliness
Coexistence provisions the common basis
real and distinct units · mutuality · activity and regulation · material and ecological conditions
provision makes humane order possible; it does not make human conduct automatic
Human understanding establishes justice
jeevan and body · knowing and evaluation · relationship · responsibility · choice
recognise relationship → fulfil value → evaluate → mutual satisfaction
Family life joins relationships, prosperity, and education
trust and other established values · assessed need · production · right-use · family council
the first reproducible field of humane conduct and intergenerational sanskar
Assemblies coordinate shared purpose without becoming a collective self
common cause, goal, and programme · participation · safeguards · public dialogue
coherence is achieved in conduct; no larger jeevan, collective atma, or literal compound is formed
Universal orderliness makes the purpose institutional and transmissible
education-sanskar · justice-security · health-restraint · production-work · exchange-reserve
family-based tiers coordinate wider responsibilities while preserving local participation
evidence and correction carry what works across persons, places, and generations
Undivided Society + Universal Orderliness
resolution · prosperity · fearlessness · coexistence, evidenced together
Each passage requires human work and remains open to evaluation; none follows mechanically from the one below.
